home.title: Richmond, drawn from open data
home.intro: Small isometric maps of Richmond, Virginia: the James River through the city in one long view, and downtown block by block from 1737 to today. Pan and zoom any map, or compare two side by side. The tool that draws them is free and open source, and prints are in the holiday shop.

heroes.title: The James, from I-195 to Rocketts Landing
heroes.blurb: The river through the heart of Richmond in one long view: Belle Isle and the falls, the bridges, Hollywood Cemetery, and downtown on the hill.

heroes.title: Downtown Richmond through time, 1737–2026
heroes.blurb: The same blocks, from the Capitol to Tobacco Row, year by year. Buildings come from fire-insurance maps and other dated sources. Pick a year below, or press [ and ] in the viewer to step through them.

sections.title: American landmarks
sections.blurb: Fifty well-known American places, each drawn in its surroundings.
